MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WITH p, date_diff('year', date(replace(p.birth_date, '/', '-')), date('2026-10-14')) AS age
WHERE (p.nationality = 'Slovenian' AND p.birth_date <> '1994/6/6')
   OR (CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) <= 2 AND age > 78)
RETURN p.nationality AS col1, p.birth_date AS col2, age AS col3, p.name AS name_player

   OR (CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) <= 2 AND age > 78)

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WITH p,
  2026 - CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) - CASE
    WHEN CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) > 10
      OR (CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) = 10 AND CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) > 14)
    THEN 1 ELSE 0
  END AS age
WHERE (p.nationality = 'Slovenian' AND p.birth_date <> '1994/6/6')
   OR (CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) <= 2 AND age > 78)
RETURN p.nationality AS col1, p.birth_date AS col2, age AS col3, p.name AS name_player
